content.text:
I've submitted index 19 (Sb fraction 0.68) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, but that value was only 0.0064%, so this pick is weak.

The whole line gave very low photoresponse:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | 0.35 | −0.0075 |
| 17 | 0.62 | −0.0009 |
| **19** | **0.68** | **0.0064** |
| 21 | 0.73 | 0.0011 |
| 26 | 0.84 | 0.0021 |

- **Reason for the pick:** index 19 is close to the CoSb₂O₆ rutile composition (Sb fraction 0.667). I focused on that region because I expected it to be the most promising, and the values dropped off on both sides of it.
- **Main caveat:** all readings are near zero, and two are negative, so index 19 may not really beat its neighbours. It could be noise.
- **Not covered:** nothing below Sb 0.35 was measured. That includes the Co-rich spinel region around Sb 0.17–0.25, so a better composition there can't be ruled out.
- **XRD not used:** I spent all 5 EQE measurements and none of the 5 XRD measurements. So I have no check that the rutile phase is actually present at index 19.
